problem_context.problem_statement: 为 CRTOS 原函数 CircularAreaInit 补充完整 separation-logic annotation 并证明全部 VC。保持 CircularAreaInit、CircularAreaReset、CircularAreaRelease 及 operations 表中 Read/Write/Release/Reset 的函数名、签名、函数体和顺序与 Ubiquitous kernel/thread/circular_area.c 一致；函数 spec 不使用参数 @pre，直接使用参数名；仅允许 parser-compatible typedef/include/外部函数声明调整与 annotation/case_lib 修改。
problem_context.expected_behavior: 精确执行长度检查、4 字节向下对齐、descriptor 分配、Reset、data_buffer 分配、p_head/p_tail/area_length/operations 初始化；成功返回完整可用 descriptor 和 buffer；每个分配失败分支按原代码精确建模，不得把第二次分配失败时实际遗留的 descriptor 资源伪装成已释放。
problem_context.input_output_contract: 覆盖输入 0、输入 1..3 对齐为 0、正常正容量、descriptor malloc 失败和 buffer malloc 失败；成功分支完整拥有 8 个 descriptor 字段、allocated buffer 及正确 operations 表关系。若原实现产生零容量对象或失败分支泄漏，规格必须诚实暴露，不能靠加强 precondition 隐藏。
spec_hint: CircularAreaReset 的 callable spec 必须能在刚分配但字段未初始化的 descriptor 上建立；malloc/free contracts 必须保持分配资源可追踪；operations 成员精确指向真实 CRTOS 函数。
forbidden_patterns: 不得修改函数体或 API；不得用 stub 函数替代 Read/Write；不得读取 QCP_demos_human；不得使用 forbidden_lemma.md 中任何 lemma。

annotation_design_summary.algorithm_mirror_review: passed: all three case-lib declarations are mathematical relations over inputs and observable descriptor state; none replay C control flow or define an execution state machine.
annotation_design_summary.allocation_failures: Descriptor allocation failure returns null with emp. Buffer allocation failure calls free only on the null buffer and therefore exposes the non-null descriptor resource as leaked, rather than claiming it was freed.
known_risks: The four generated manual return witnesses must choose the path-appropriate postcondition branch and discharge unsigned alignment normalization.
The success witness must normalize unsigned_last_nbits and byte-sized pointer_offset to the mathematical aligned length.
annotation_design_summary.mathematical_semantics: CircularAreaAlignedLength states exact four-byte downward alignment, CircularAreaInitDescriptorState states the complete successful descriptor value relation, and CircularAreaInitLeakedDescriptorState states exactly the initialized portion retained after a null buffer allocation.
annotation_design_summary.memory_contract: Successful initialization returns ownership of all eight descriptor fields and UCharArray::undef_full(data_buffer, aligned). Buffer allocation failure returns null while retaining ownership of all eight descriptor fields; p_head, p_tail, area_length, and CircularAreaOperations remain uninitialized permissions exactly as in the implementation.
annotation_design_summary.operations_relation: The successful descriptor's CircularAreaOperations field is exactly &CircularAreaOperations, whose static initializer preserves the original Read, Write, Release, Reset order.
annotation_design_summary.zero_capacity_behavior: requested = 0 returns null before allocation; requested in 1..3 aligns to zero and then follows the allocator result without a strengthened precondition.
